tspan.tspan: Proportions refer to the proportion of time during which each behavior was observed.
Social gaze was computed over each cube demonstration, whereas the other measures
were computed over each cube-exposure period.
HPD = 95% Highest Posterior Density interval. A post-hoc difference was considered
statistically credible when its 95% HPD interval did not include 0.
